why:
the action client's constructor. rclcpp_action reaches a client through `rclcpp_action::create_client(...)`, which returns a `SharedPtr`; ours is default-constructed by the caller and initialised in place by `Node::create_action_client(out, name, qos)` -- the `out-param-first` and `no-shared-ptr` rules, because there is no allocator (RFC-0022). Copy is `= delete`d and move is the only transfer. Exactly the shape recorded one entity over at `cpp:Publisher::Publisher<M>`; the theirs-only half is `cpp:Client::Client<ActionT>`.

phase-428 (RFC-0089): re-keyed by the namespace flip. `nros::ActionClient<A>` / `nros::ActionServer<A>` are now aliases of `rclcpp_action::Client<A>` / `rclcpp_action::Server<A>`, which the extractor keys as `Client::*` / `Server::*`. The type is `same` now and the member is `ours-only`, so it no longer inherits its type's verdict and carries its own.
